description: Static NPCs for town hub: quest givers, vendors. Reusable Sprite2D + collision + interact. Refactors player movement into character base. Inspired by Ragnarok Online dialogs and sprites.
acceptance_criteria: NPC scene/component reusable (Sprite2D + idle anim + CollisionShape2D solid)
Static only — no movement or patrol
Auto face player on sprite-click interaction (4-dir LPC)
Clicking an NPC sprite triggers 'interacted' signal + basic dialog/quest UI hook
NpcState model pure: idle state, facing, current_quest
All behaviors covered by executable GDScript spec (RED first)
Follows player camera, no perf impact (static, signal-driven)
inspiration: Ragnarok Online — sprite NPCs, clickable dialog, face player, quest/shop via choices, collision + talk range
